sloka: अमरेन्द्र मया बह्व्यः प्रजाः सृष्टास्तथा प्रभो ।एकवर्णाः समाभाषा एकरूपाश्च सर्वशः ।। ७.३०.२१ ॥
transliteration: amarendra mayā bahvyaḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭāstathā prabho ।ekavarṇāḥ samābhāṣā ekarūpāśca sarvaśaḥ ।। 7.30.21 ॥

translations.english: O Lord Indra, I created many beings who were all of the same color, spoke the same language, and had the same form in every respect.
